name: Pivot
tagline: Drag fields onto a grid. The table is the save. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Drop a spreadsheet, or start from the baked sample of Canadian MPs. Drag names onto rows and columns. Pick a count, a sum, or a list. The grid rearranges as you drag — a pivot table, in the file, on this device.

Paste or type comma-separated text if you have no file. Change the view (table, heatmap, TSV) from the menu in the corner. Close the app and come back: the last table and the last arrangement come back with it. There is no account, and nothing is sent anywhere.

An unofficial port of PivotTable.js by Nicolas Kruchten. Same drag-and-drop grid. Charts that need extra libraries are not in this app.
